tagline: Turns recorded sales calls into short coaching notes for the rep

source.excerpt: Shared as post-call coaching for sales managers working from recordings they already have.

body:
## What it does

Works from what was already captured, once the conversation is over. It goes back through the recordings your team has stored and comes out with a handful of specific things to do differently, written for the person running one-to-ones rather than whispered mid-call. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @scottxmetcalf shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
